newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sunkyong Group targets '97 sales at 36 trln won.
newsitem.headline: Sunkyong Group targets '97 sales at 36 trln won.

text.p: South Korea's Sunkyong Group said on Wednesday it had set the 1997 sales target for its 32 member companies at a combined 36 trillion won, compared with 31 trillion targetted for this year.

The group said in a statement its total investment would reach five trillion won next year, up from 4.5 trillion won in 1996. The investment includes spending on facilities and research and development.
Sunkyong Group, one of South Korea's top 10 conglomerates, is the first major business group in the nation to announce its sales plan for next year.
The statement said the 1997 sales target for Sunkyong Ltd, a trading firm of the group, was set at 5.2 trillion won, up from 4.5 trillion won for 1996.
Sales of Yukong Ltd, an oil refiner and a petrochemical maker, would reach 9.0 trillion won in 1997, compared with 8.2 trillion won this year, the statement said.
The sales target for Sunkyong Industries Inc, a textile maker, was set at 850 billion in 1997, compared with this year's target of 800 billion won, the statement said.
Four of Sunkyong Group's 32 member companies are listed on the Seoul stock market. The sales target for Sunkyong Securities Co was not announced.
